crossRefs.note: but to Hannah he gave a double portion, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.
He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank…

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’ ”
translations.bsb: And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.”
translations.kjv: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
translations.asv: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
